segment.source: We supply a series of design principles, practical patterns and high quality design resources (Sketch and Axure), to help people create their product prototypes beautifully and efficiently.
segment.target: Nós supply a series de design principles, practical patterns e high quality design resources (Sketch e Axure), para help people criar their product prototypes beautifully e efficiently.

segment.source: Skeleton provides lightweight visual placeholders before content is available, covering text, avatar, image, input, button, and custom node states.
segment.target: Skeleton provides leve visual placeholders antes conteúdo é disponível, covering texto, avatar, imagem, entrada, botão, e personalizado nó states.

segment.target: Elemento avatar com display inline-block, alinhamento vertical, cor de fundo, tamanho, raio da borda e outros estilos de placeholder do avatar.

segment.source: Content element with placeholder background, border, radius and size styles.
